The '''Antiviral kit MK-1''' was manufactured by [[The Hyland Organization for Rakghoul Neutralization]] (THORN). It provided temporary immunity to the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]] as long as it was equipped. The [[Antiviral kit MK-2]] and [[Antiviral kit MK-3|MK-3]] where more powerful versions of the MK-1. [[Captain/Legends|Captains]] [[Erimus Moayoi]] and [[Lahoa Diatog]] of THORN sold Antiviral kit MK-1s.
